Yes, that's a real thing to sort out, and it's one for your doctor, not me. Beta blockers can change how your heart rate responds to effort, so zones based on a standard formula or a watch may not mean what they normally do. Your doctor or pharmacist can tell you how it applies to you and whether they want you to train to a different target.

In the meantime, you can still train by feel. Effort ratings, like how hard a set felt or whether you can hold a conversation on a run, don't depend on your pulse. Want me to build a session or plan around that?
